Rush not into fights. Long is the war. Only by surviving it, will you prevail.|[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Yoda, to Thire|audio=YodaThire.flac|{{TCW|Ambush}}}} '''Thire''', also known by the number '''CC-4477''', was a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]], and was later the [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] of the elite [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. ==Biography== ===Mission to Rugosa=== {{Quote|Hmm... learned something day, have you lieutenant, hmm?''"
"''I think we all did, General.|Yoda and Thire|}} {{Main|Battle of Rugosa/Legends}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' early in the war, Thire, serving as a lieutenant in the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], was assigned, alongside troopers [[Jek/Legends|Jek]] and [[Rys/Legends|Rys]], to escort [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] during a diplomatic [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|mission to Rugosa]] to meet with the neutral king of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]], [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]]. When their [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigate]] was ambushed by two [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], Yoda and the three troopers escaped the transport while it fled and made their way to the moon's surface in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Arriving in the moon's thick [[Rugosa land coral|coral]] jungle, CC-4477 patched into the King's communication system, allowing Yoda to speak to Katuunko through a [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]]. The King was pleased to see that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was not frightened away by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Yoda became aware of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' presence, as the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] proposed a contest to demonstrate which side was superior. Ventress would dispatch her forces to capture Yoda, and if he defeated them, the Toydarians would join the Republic, however if the droid forces defeated Yoda, the King should consider joining the Confederacy. [[File:Thire-TCW.png|thumb|left|180px|Thire in Phase I armor]] Agreeing to the challenge, Yoda and the clones made their way into the dense coral forest. In pursuit was a column of Confederate forces led by [[224/Legends|224]] in his [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. However, the droids were forced to continue on foot after the tanks were unable to get through due to the dense foliage. Thire, Rys, and Jek split from Master Yoda to use their surroundings. The clones took cover and engaged a squad of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] from the south and defeated them, but [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] soon followed, and the three were forced to flee. During their escape Thire was hit by a [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] launched by a B2-HA series super battle droid''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''. With Thire injured and pinned behind a rock with Rys and Jek, the clones prepared to make a final stand, but Yoda came to their aid using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|turn around]] the B2 battle droid and destroy the rest of its squad. The small victory was short lived as [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] soon appeared which caused the Republic forces to flee. Yoda clung onto CC-4477's back and deflected the lasers at a nearby tall formation of land coral, causing the droids to be crushed, and the four escaped to a cave to rest. Lieutenant Thire and the other clones learned that they were low on ammunition and their morale ran low, but the Jedi Master imparted his wisdom on the clone troopers, telling Thire to have patience, rather than rush headlong into battle. Their quiet contemplation on Yoda's words was interrupted by the sound of the droids approaching. Venturing out of the cave the four looked down on the droid column. Yoda ordered the clones to stay on the ridge and said that he would go in alone, stating that they will know when to help him. Thire and his men looked on as Yoda single-handedly took out the droid column. However the clones spotted droidekas approaching an unaware Yoda. Just as the last AAT was destroyed, the droidekas fired upon Yoda. While Yoda was deflecting laser blasts, Thire fired the squad's remaining rocket into an overhanging cliff, causing an avalanche to crash down on the droideka reinforcements, saving Yoda. With Ventress' forces defeated the group headed back to the rendezvous to meet with Katuunko. ===Promotion=== Following his graduation from the [[ARC program/Legends|ARC training program]] and a promotion to the rank of [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]], Thire was placed as a leader of the Coruscant Guard.{{DB|character|commanderthire|Thire}} Together with [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], the two founded [[Homeworld Security Command]] in an effort to centralize and streamline the defense of Coruscant should an attack ever come. A part of Thire, however, always felt as though the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] would never be able to muster a reliable defense of Coruscant.''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' ===Battle of Coruscant=== {{Main|Battle of Coruscant/Legends}} Thire's worst fears were realized when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|surprise attack]] on the capital in the early hours of the morning. Thire's men, in conjunction with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]]'s [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], did their best to keep the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] from taking the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. While they were able to halt the Separatist advance, they were powerless to stop the abduction of the Chancellor by Grievous and his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]]. ===Order 66=== [[File:Thiresenate.png|thumb|right|220x220px|Thire searches for Yoda's body.]] {{Dialogue|Thire|There's no sign of his body, sir.|Amedda|Then he's not dead.|Palpatine|Double your search!|Thire|Yes, sir! Right away, sir!|attr=Commander Thire, Mas Amedda, and Palpatine search for Yoda|src={{Film|III}}}} The execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the 501st Legion's [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|assault]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] brought about the end of the Clone Wars and the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. After an epic battle in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]] between [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and Jedi Master Yoda, the Emperor tasked Commander Thire and his men to scour the bowels of the Senate, looking for any sign of the diminutive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], ironically forcing Thire to hunt down the very Jedi Master who saved his life on the [[Rugosa/Legends|Coral moon]]. Although Thire's increased efforts to find Yoda had failed, the Emperor was far more concerned with the status of his newest [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], whom he sensed was in grave danger. Thus, Thire and his shock troopers accompanied Palpatine to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where they brought the [[Medical capsule/Legends|medical capsule]] to the gravely injured [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], now Darth Vader. ===Imperial service=== Thire served as one of Palpatine's personal guards on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and during off-world trips. As the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] grip around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] tightened, Thire saw his shock troopers transformed into the foundation of the Imperial era Coruscant Guard, which was tasked with the security of the Imperial capital. ==Behind the scenes== Thire was voiced by [[Temuera Morrison]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode ''[[Ambush]]'' he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] along with all other clones in the series.
